summary.text: Amy Walen is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 48-Position 2, where she has served since January 2019, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner, with a background in finance and human resources.

paragraphs.text: Amy Walen earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Queensland in 1990.
Her career experience includes working as a business owner with a background in finance and human resources.
She took office in the Washington House on January 14, 2019.

Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Civil Rights & Judiciary, Community Safety, Justice, & Reentry, Consumer Protection & Business (Chair), Finance, and Economic Development & International Relations.
